pricing.faq.connect.question: How do I connect my WhatsApp number to the AI automation platform?
pricing.faq.connect.answer: We use Meta's official WhatsApp Business Cloud API. You simply verify your business and link your phone number ID. It's 100% secure, fully compliant, and ensures maximum message delivery rates.
pricing.faq.support_bookings.question: Can the AI copilot handle customer support and bookings simultaneously?

pricing.faq.crm.question: Can I integrate my existing CRM with your WhatsApp automation?
pricing.faq.ban.question: Will my WhatsApp account get banned for using automation?
pricing.cta.title: Ready to Transform Customer Communication?
pricing.cta.description: Join thousands of high-growth teams who automate WhatsApp messages, nurture leads, and scale conversion pipelines automatically.
pricing.faq.support_bookings.answer: Yes! Our AI is trained to understand context. It can answer FAQs, route complex queries to your human agents, and instantly trigger WhatsApp booking flows right inside the chat.
pricing.faq.broadcast_limits.answer: Broadcast limits are determined by your Meta API tier (starting at 1,000 to 100K+ messages/day). Our platform seamlessly supports high-volume broadcasts for your marketing campaigns without throttling.
pricing.faq.crm.answer: Absolutely. We offer native integrations for HubSpot, Salesforce, and custom webhooks. Whenever a lead interacts with your WhatsApp bot, their profile and chat history automatically sync to your CRM.
pricing.faq.ban.answer: No. Because we use the official Meta Cloud API, you are fully compliant with WhatsApp's terms of service. You will not risk being banned, unlike unofficial web scraping tools.
